remarks:
This meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5 bathroom, 2,292 sq. ft. ranch-style home offers an impressive combination of comfortable living, usable acreage, and exceptional garage and workshop space located in Belmont NY, Allegany County.

Designed with everyday living in mind, the kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry and counter space, an island, and bar seating. The adjoining dining room provides ample space for family meals and special occasions, while the spacious living room offers a comfortable place to relax and entertain. A double-sided wood-burning fireplace connects the living areas, with brick on the kitchen-dining side and natural fieldstone on the living-room side.

The home features a four-season sunroom where a vaulted ceiling and expansive windows bring in abundant natural light and showcase views across the property. Sliding glass doors open to the large wrap-around deck, extending the living space outdoors for dining, relaxing, and watching wildlife. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet, complemented by two additional bedrooms and two full baths. A dedicated mudroom-laundry area with a convenient half bath adds everyday functionality, while the full basement provides valuable storage, hobby, and workspace.  Recent improvements include a high-efficiency furnace, hot water tank, refrigerator, and the sunroom mini-split.

Outside, a paved driveway offers ample parking and access to an attached two-car garage with additional office-storage space. A newer detached two-car garage with shop area adds even more room for vehicles, equipment, projects, or a home workspace.

The 16.85 acres include expansive front and rear lawns, an open field, and adjoining woods, plenty of room for kids, pets, gardening, recreation, a potential food plot, and whitetail deer hunting.

Just minutes from Belmont and a convenient drive to Alfred and Houghton, this property offers something increasingly hard to find: a well-kept ranch, useful acreage, outstanding outbuildings, and room for family life to grow. All rights convey.
